title: Nexus AI Pipeline Run Contract
description: Machine-readable JSON Schema (draft 2020-12) for a Nexus AI Pipeline Run, derived from docs/nexus-ai-orchestration-model/legacy/07-pipeline-contract-standard.md section 3 (Pipeline Run Contract) and configs/nexus-ai/pipeline_contract_standard.yaml (pipeline_run_required_fields). Locked decisions enforced: no 'plugin' concept anywhere; owner_agent is always a snake_case pipeline Agent ROLE and is never a Core Ability; embedded stage_contract objects must declare all 7 usage-mapping arrays. Documentation/blueprint only -- not runtime code.
$comment: Core Abilities (Supervisor, Coder, Vision, Audio, Creative, Memory, Web, OS) are NOT agents and NEVER valid owner_agent values. owner_team=sdlc_team, team_lead=sdlc_team_lead for the SDLC pipeline. Skill != Tool; Governance != Audit; Evidence != Trace.

coreAbility.description: Closed set of Core Abilities. Core Abilities are an independent capability layer -- never agents, never team members, never owner_agent.

forbiddenPlugin.$comment: LOCKED: Plugin is cancelled. No 'plugin' property (any casing) may appear at any object level. Mirrors the sibling schemas' [Pp][Ll][Uu][Gg][Ii][Nn] guard.

ownerAgentRole.description: owner_agent is always a pipeline Agent ROLE in snake_case (e.g. requirements_agent). It must NEVER be a Core Ability (Supervisor, Coder, Vision, Audio, Creative, Memory, Web, OS) in any casing.

terminalOrStage.$comment: Routing target: a known stage_id (snake_case) or a canonical terminal.

stageContract.description: Embedded Pipeline Stage Contract. Mirrors the STAGE CONTRACT TEMPLATE key order. All 7 usage-mapping arrays are REQUIRED (may be empty []). owner_agent is a role, never a Core Ability. Plugin properties are forbidden.
stageContract.$comment: Kept self-contained so this file validates standalone. It is the run-embedded counterpart of the canonical standalone schema configs/nexus-ai/schemas/stage_contract.schema.json (07 section 4); a bundler may replace this with a $ref to that $id. Constraints here are intentionally a subset/superset-compatible mirror of that schema.

applicability_decision.description: Present only on CONDITIONAL stages; appears right after purpose. Must carry a required_when expression.

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this pipeline run.

pipeline_id.description: Identifier of the pipeline definition this run executes (snake_case, e.g. sdlc_pipeline).

pipeline_version.description: Version of the pipeline definition this run executes.

run_goal.description: The concrete goal/intent of this run.

selected_pipeline.description: The pipeline selected for this run (snake_case pipeline id).

assigned_team.description: Team assigned to this run. For the SDLC pipeline this is sdlc_team.

team_lead.description: Team lead role driving the run. For the SDLC pipeline this is sdlc_team_lead (Supervisor is a Core Ability and is NOT the team lead).

active_stage.description: stage_id of the currently active stage, or a canonical terminal.

run_context.description: Run-scoped context / memory state (e.g. references to context-memory profiles such as sdlc_run_context).

governance_state.description: Current governance state for the run (active governance profiles, gate posture, policy outcomes). Governance is kept distinct from Audit.

evidence.description: Evidence items produced by the run (decision evidence). Evidence is DISTINCT from trace.

trace.description: Trace items recorded by the run (operation/activation history). Trace is DISTINCT from evidence.

used_core_abilities.description: Core Abilities actually used during the run. Closed set; never includes agents.

used_skills.description: Skills actually used during the run (e.g. prism, verification-loop). Skill != Tool.

used_tools.description: Tools actually invoked during the run (snake_case tool ids). Tool != Skill.

used_governance_profiles.description: Governance profiles applied during the run.

used_audit_schemas.description: Audit schemas (evidence/trace) used during the run.

used_model_provider_profiles.description: Model / provider profiles used during the run.

used_context_memory_profiles.description: Context / memory profiles used during the run.

open_questions.description: Open questions raised during the run (e.g. registry formalization items).

next_action.description: The next action for the run: a target stage_id or a canonical terminal (done, relevant_failed_stage, block_and_report).

stage_contracts.description: Optional embedded stage contracts referenced by this run. Each must declare all 7 usage-mapping arrays and use a role (never a Core Ability) for owner_agent.
